text: Rare Candy lets you evolve a Basic Pokémon directly into a Stage 2 Pokémon. Use it as a grounded reference when the user asks about Rare Candy legality.
A Pokémon normally cannot evolve on the same turn it was played to the Bench unless an effect says otherwise. This is the first-turn evolution restriction the UI can cite.
You may attach one Energy card from your hand to one of your Pokémon during your turn. If the question is about attachment timing, this chunk is a concise citation.
When you Knock Out an opponent's Pokémon, you take Prize cards equal to that Pokémon's Prize value. This supports basic prize-card questions in the UI.
